Ravi Malhotra: Quick follow-up from the throttling postmortemI compiled action items + suggested owners, pls ack or reassign by EOD.
Ellen Park: Paste the actions here so I can claim infra ones.
Ravi Malhotra: Inline list (short):
- Item 1: Add short-window circuit + 429+Retry-After at edge (owner:Ellen, due:2026-04-05, JIRA: RED-2401)
- Item 2: Build KV-cache warmup on scale-up to avoid cold misses (owner:Jonas, due:2026-04-18, JIRA: RED-2402)
- Item 3: Cross-incident recurrence review + epic proposal (owner:Claire, due:2026-04-25, JIRA: RED-2403)
- Item 4: Update PM doc + RACI matrix, ensure temp_owner field in template (owner:Ravi, due:2026-03-31, no-jira)
Jonas Weber: I can take Item 2 but need access to the perf traces and the sim-load script. @Ravi can you share?
Ravi Malhotra: Traces + sim script at s3://pm-data/throttling/2026-03, granted access to Jonas and Ellen.
Claire Duarte: For Item 3 I'll aggregate related PMs from 2025-09 and 2025-11 and open RED-2403 as an epic. Adding a "recurrence" label and checklist for long-term mitigations.
PMAssistantBot: Created JIRA RED-2401, RED-2402, RED-2403 (links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2401 etc.)
Ellen Park: For Item 1 rollout plan: feature-flagged, 30% canary for 48h, monitor P99 lat and 429 rate. Will add the runbook snippet to RED-2401.
Jonas Weber: Noted. Will start a small perf harness job to reproduce the cold-warm transition and attach results to RED-2402.
Ravi Malhotra: RACI draft: Item1 resp=Ellen acct=InfraLead consult=ML-eng informed=CS. Item2 resp=Jonas acct=PlatformLead consult=Infra informed=Operations. I'll paste final RACI into the PM doc.
Claire Duarte: Can we have a 15m weekly owners sync until all tickets are "In Progress"? Tue 11:00AM suggested.
Ellen Park: Works for me. Please send invite.
Ravi Malhotra: Calendar invite sent and I'll post a one-line owner status after each sync in the PM doc. Final ask: please update the Jira owner field and comment "owner-accept" by EOD. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
